Lacquer is a mastering assistant for Ableton Live. Pick a style, pick where
the song is going (streaming, download, CD or vinyl), press LEARN and play
the song. One MASTER knob sets how much EQ, compression, saturation and
width goes on, and the limiter lands the loudness on the target. Put it last
on the master channel.

## Install

Unzip and copy `Lacquer.vst3` into your VST3 folder (macOS
`~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3`, Windows `C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3`,
Linux `~/.vst3`), then rescan plug-ins in Live. The guide (PDF) in the
download explains mastering from the start and walks you through a session.

**macOS:** the plugin isn't notarised. If macOS refuses to load it, run
`xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/Lacquer.vst3`.
